title: File and Data Search Tools
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools for performing semantic searches across various file types, data sources, and online content. It includes specialized tools for querying CSV, DOCX, JSON, PDF, TXT, XML files, directories, GitHub repositories, and database tables like MySQL, SingleStore, and Snowflake, as well as web content from websites and YouTube.

nodes.label: RAG Tool Base
nodes.title: Base for RAG-enabled Search Tools
nodes.description: Provides foundational capabilities for tools that perform semantic search using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) principles, handling data ingestion and query processing.

nodes.label: Base Tool Interface
nodes.title: Core Tool Interface
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface and common functionalities for all tools within the CrewAI ecosystem, including name, description, and argument schema.

nodes.label: Search CSV Content
nodes.title: CSV Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within the content of a specified CSV file, allowing agents to extract relevant information based on natural language queries.

nodes.label: Search Directory Content
nodes.title: Directory Content Search Tool
nodes.description: Allows semantic search across all files within a specified directory, providing a unified way to find information across multiple documents.

nodes.label: Search DOCX Content
nodes.title: DOCX Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Facilitates semantic search within the content of a specified DOCX document, enabling agents to query and retrieve information from Word files.

nodes.label: Search GitHub Repo Content
nodes.title: GitHub Repository Search Tool
nodes.description: Provides semantic search capabilities for content within a GitHub repository, including code, issues, and pull requests, without using the GitHub API directly.

nodes.label: Search JSON Content
nodes.title: JSON Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Allows semantic search within the content of a specified JSON file, enabling agents to query structured data efficiently.

nodes.label: Search MDX Content
nodes.title: MDX Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within the content of a specified MDX file, useful for querying documentation or content written in MDX format.

nodes.label: Search MySQL Table Content
nodes.title: MySQL Database Search Tool
nodes.description: Performs semantic search within the content of a specified MySQL database table, allowing agents to retrieve information from relational databases.

nodes.label: Search PDF Content
nodes.title: PDF Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Facilitates semantic search within the content of a specified PDF document, enabling agents to extract information from PDF files.

nodes.label: Search SingleStore DB Content
nodes.title: SingleStore Database Search Tool
nodes.description: Provides a secure interface for executing SELECT and SHOW queries against a SingleStore database, supporting semantic search and efficient connection management.

nodes.label: Search Snowflake DB Content
nodes.title: Snowflake Data Warehouse Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables execution of SQL queries and semantic search on Snowflake data warehouses, with features like connection pooling, retries, and caching.

nodes.label: Search TXT Content
nodes.title: TXT Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Allows semantic search within the content of a specified plain text file, useful for extracting information from simple text documents.

nodes.label: Search Website Content
nodes.title: Website Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within the content of a specified website URL, allowing agents to query and retrieve information directly from web pages.

nodes.label: Search XML Content
nodes.title: XML Semantic Search Tool
nodes.description: Facilitates semantic search within the content of a specified XML file, enabling agents to query structured data in XML format.

nodes.label: Search YouTube Channel Content
nodes.title: YouTube Channel Search Tool
nodes.description: Provides semantic search capabilities for content across a specified YouTube channel, allowing agents to find relevant information from channel videos.

nodes.label: Search YouTube Video Content
nodes.title: YouTube Video Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within the content of a specified YouTube video, allowing agents to extract information from video transcripts or descriptions.

groups.label: File Content Search
groups.title: Tools for Searching File Content
groups.description: A collection of tools designed for semantic search within various document and data file formats.

groups.label: Directory & Repository Search
groups.title: Tools for Searching Directories and Repositories
groups.description: Tools enabling semantic search across local file directories and remote GitHub repositories.

groups.label: Database Search
groups.title: Tools for Searching Database Content
groups.description: Specialized tools for performing semantic queries against various database systems like MySQL, SingleStore, and Snowflake.

groups.label: Web Content Search
groups.title: Tools for Searching Web Content
groups.description: Tools dedicated to semantic search on online web content, including general websites and specific YouTube channels or videos.
